zh-CN.title: 个性化展示更准确
items: 已下线的 VIP 专有头像框和发言卡片外观不再因旧账号数据重新出现
PWA 与小程序均会先选择空间，再进入普通用户登录并保留微信登录选项

en.title: More accurate personalization
items: Retired VIP avatar frames and statement-card appearances no longer resurface from legacy account data
The PWA and mini program now choose a space before member sign-in, with WeChat sign-in still available
